column4: Description
Complete lower machine — base casting + neck/post + all controls and electrical; everything below the motor head
BASE / BODY — BAS-
Cast-aluminum body; 4 wells in 2x2 grid + forward control tongue; wrinkle-black finish. Forward at bottom; straight L/R sides; broad rounded bottom.

Front-left well — the TALL raised tube (7.375 total height). CORRECTION: interior bore 3.800 is SMALLER than the jar bays (3.955), not larger — it is the taller well, not wider. Interior: cast-top ring/ledge (central octagonal opening) at 4.9075 down; R1 (CTL-007) suspended in the gap below it; cast bottom ~2.55 further down. Basket parks above R1 for radiant drying.
Three equal-bore wells (front-right + rear-right + rear-left) for the cleaning/rinse solution jars. QTY 3.

Forward teardrop/paddle face (26.6deg forward-down ramp) carrying the rheostat knob (on a FLAT face — no cast recess), jewel lamp, plunger and toggle. Widths 4.80->3.80->2.00; control holes: rheostat shaft 0.395, jewel/plunger/toggle 0.490 each.

Raised cast lettering "L&R MASTER" in a smile arc, plus "OFF" and "ON->" sweep, on the FLAT tongue face around the rheostat shaft hole (there is NO recess). Repro: letters ~0.489 cap height, arc chord 3.138, arc struck ~2.75 radius from a center up the casting; Franklin Gothic Condensed / News Gothic style.

Central cast SQUARE socket where the post (NCK-001) seats: inside across-flats 1.300 (fit-critical), depth 2.9035 (~full body height). NO oil/access bore. CORRECTION: secured by 6 screws in 2 functional groups (NOT "3 through + 1 set"): 4 SET screws that only touch/tension the post (1 large 3/8 on side A + three 1/2in set screws on sides A/B/C) + 2 POST screws (sides B/C) that thread INTO the post. Side D blank. Heavily corroded internally (prior restoration).
Rubber bushing where the AC line cord passes through the casting wall. Original DISINTEGRATED (hardened/brittle) — REPLACE.
